judgments.rationale: P0002 incorrectly designates C0002 as the qualified baseline. Subparagraph (B)(i) establishes an exception to the pre-filing notice requirements of Subparagraph (A) (represented by C0000), rather than qualifying the concurrent filing requirement in clause (ii) (represented by C0002).

P0000 structures the action as providing notice while designating Subparagraph (A) as the object. Subparagraph (A) is the legal requirement that shall not apply, not the direct object of the action of providing notice. This artificial structuring distorts the semantic relationship expressed in the statutory text.

P0001 correctly links exemption C0001 to baseline requirement C0000 with the relation 'exception'. It appropriately leaves action and object unstructured rather than imposing an artificial direct object, refines the actor and scope to faithful statutory language, and accurately incorporates the companion notification context from clause (ii).

P0002.rationale: P0002 incorrectly designates C0002 as the qualified baseline. Subparagraph (B)(i) establishes an exception to the pre-filing notice requirements of Subparagraph (A) (represented by C0000), rather than qualifying the concurrent filing requirement in clause (ii) (represented by C0002).

source_spans.quote:
(A) In general Before filing an action under paragraph (1), the attorney general of the State involved shall provide to the Commission—

(i) written notice of that action; and

(ii) a copy of the complaint for that action.


(B) Exemption

(i) In general

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.

(ii) Notification

In an action described in clause (i), the attorney general of a State shall provide notice and a copy of the complaint to the Commission at the same time as the attorney general files the action.
